items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: we used to play that with Sidney DeVille when we was working at his club.

ctx.x: I heard that from someone that you did that on some of those tunes, maybe that you hadn't known too well, like, I can't think of the tune, Canal Street Blues or something like that.
No. I never heard that played on a recording, because we used to play that with Sidney DeVille when we was working at his club. Which one was that? The Mardi Gras.
